quests.instruction: Your mother's mother's sister is your ___?
quests.question: Great-Aunt
quests.hint: Your mother's mother is your grandmother — her sister holds this title for you.
quests.explanation: Your mother's mother's sister is your great-aunt, since your mother's mother is your grandmother.
quests.funFact: This three-step chain shows how family words can stack together across generations!

quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: This boy calls you 'Aunt' or 'Uncle'.
quests.explanation: Your brother's son is your nephew.
quests.funFact: You become an uncle or aunt the moment your sibling has a child!

quests.question: Granddaughter
quests.hint: She is your own daughter's little girl.
quests.explanation: Your daughter's daughter is your granddaughter.
quests.funFact: The same girl is a granddaughter to you and a daughter to your own daughter!

quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: Your grandmother has exactly one mother — she is this relative.
quests.explanation: Your grandmother's mother is your great-grandmother.
quests.funFact: Meeting a great-grandmother lets you connect with family history from even further back!

quests.question: Great-Grandfather
quests.hint: Your grandfather has exactly one father — he is this relative.
quests.explanation: Your grandfather's father is your great-grandfather.
quests.funFact: Meeting a great-grandfather lets you connect with family history from even further back!

quests.instruction: Your mother's brother's child is your ___?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: Your mother's brother is your uncle — his child holds this title for you.
quests.explanation: Your mother's brother's child is your cousin, since your mother's brother is your uncle.
quests.funFact: Cousins connected through your mother's side and your father's side are equally your cousins!

quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: Count up just one generation from your mother.
quests.explanation: Your mother's mother is your grandmother.
quests.funFact: Working out puzzles like this is exactly how family trees get built, one link at a time!

quests.question: Great-Uncle
quests.hint: He is your grandfather's own sibling.
quests.explanation: Your grandfather's brother is your great-uncle.
quests.funFact: A great-uncle often remembers stories from even further back than your own grandfather's childhood!

quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: He is your mother's own sibling.
quests.explanation: Your mother's brother is your uncle.
quests.funFact: An uncle on your mother's side is connected to you through her side of the family!

quests.instruction: If a boy calls you 'Grandma' or 'Grandpa', what is he to you?
quests.question: Grandson
quests.hint: This boy is the son of one of your own children.
quests.explanation: If a boy calls you 'Grandma' or 'Grandpa', he is your grandson.
quests.funFact: Family titles work in pairs — if he calls you 'Grandpa', you call him 'Grandson' right back!

quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: She is your mother's own sibling, not your mother herself.
quests.explanation: Your mother's sister is your aunt.
quests.funFact: You might have several aunts if your mother has more than one sister!

quests.instruction: What does your sibling's son call your father?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: Your sibling's son is your nephew, and your father is your nephew's grandparent.
quests.explanation: Your sibling's son calls your father 'Grandfather', since your father is his grandparent too.
quests.funFact: The very same man is 'Father' to you and 'Grandfather' to your niece or nephew, all at once!

quests.instruction: If a girl calls you 'Aunt' or 'Uncle', what is she to you?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: This girl is your own sibling's daughter.
quests.explanation: If a girl calls you 'Aunt' or 'Uncle', she is your niece.
quests.funFact: Family titles work in pairs — if she calls you 'Aunt', you call her 'Niece' right back!

quests.question: Great-Aunt
quests.hint: She is your grandfather's own sibling, one generation further than an aunt.
quests.explanation: Your grandfather's sister is your great-aunt.
quests.funFact: Great-aunts and great-uncles are wonderful sources of extra-old family stories!

quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: He is your own sister's boy.
quests.explanation: Your sister's son is your nephew.
quests.funFact: A nephew and a niece from the same parents are also brother and sister to each other!

quests.question: Granddaughter
quests.hint: She is two generations below you, and is a girl.
quests.explanation: Your son's daughter is your granddaughter.
quests.funFact: The same girl is a granddaughter to you and a daughter to your own son!

quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: Your grandfather has exactly one mother — she is this relative.
quests.explanation: Your grandfather's mother is your great-grandmother.
quests.funFact: Your grandfather grew up being raised by his own mother, just like you were raised by yours!

quests.question: Great-Grandfather
quests.hint: This man raised the grandfather or grandmother you already know.
quests.explanation: Your parent's grandfather is your great-grandfather.
quests.funFact: Your parent grew up hearing stories from their own grandfather, just as you might from yours!

quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: She shares a grandparent with you, but not a parent.
quests.explanation: Your uncle's daughter is your cousin.
quests.funFact: Your uncle's daughter calls your own mother or father 'Aunt' or 'Uncle' right back!

quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: Your father has exactly one mother — she is this relative.
quests.explanation: Your father's mother is your grandmother.
quests.funFact: You can have up to two grandmothers: your mother's mother and your father's mother!

quests.instruction: Your father's father's brother is your ___?
quests.question: Great-Uncle
quests.hint: Your father's father is your grandfather — his brother holds this title for you.
quests.explanation: Your father's father's brother is your great-uncle, since your father's father is your grandfather.
quests.funFact: Every extra 'great-' added to a title means one more generation of distance!

quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: He is your father's own sibling, not your father himself.
quests.explanation: Your father's brother is your uncle.
quests.funFact: You might have several uncles if your father has more than one brother!

quests.question: Grandson
quests.hint: He is your own son's little boy.
quests.explanation: Your son's son is your grandson.
quests.funFact: The same boy is a grandson to you and a son to your own son!

quests.instruction: What does your cousin call your mother?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: Your cousin's parent is your mother's own sibling — so your mother holds this title to your cousin.
quests.explanation: Your cousin calls your mother 'Aunt', since your mother is your cousin's parent's sibling.
quests.funFact: The very same woman is 'Mother' to you and 'Aunt' to your cousin, all at once!

quests.instruction: If a man calls you 'grandson' or 'granddaughter', what is he to you?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: He is one generation above your own parent.
quests.explanation: If a man calls you 'grandson' or 'granddaughter', he is your grandfather.
quests.funFact: Family titles work in pairs — if he calls you his grandchild, you call him 'Grandfather' right back!

quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: She is your own brother's girl.
quests.explanation: Your brother's daughter is your niece.
quests.funFact: A niece and a nephew from the same parents are also brother and sister to each other!

quests.question: Great-Aunt
quests.hint: She is your grandmother's own sibling.
quests.explanation: Your grandmother's sister is your great-aunt.
quests.funFact: A great-aunt often remembers stories from even further back than your own grandmother's childhood!

quests.instruction: If a boy calls you 'Uncle' or 'Aunt', what is he to you?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: This boy is your own sibling's son.
quests.explanation: If a boy calls you 'Uncle' or 'Aunt', he is your nephew.
quests.funFact: Family titles work in pairs — if he calls you 'Uncle', you call him 'Nephew' right back!

quests.instruction: Your child's daughter, whether your son's or your daughter's, is your ___?
quests.question: Granddaughter
quests.hint: It does not matter which of your children — their daughter always holds this title.
quests.explanation: Your child's daughter, whether your son's or your daughter's, is your granddaughter.
quests.funFact: This word works no matter which of your children the girl belongs to!

quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: He shares a grandparent with you, but not a parent.
quests.explanation: Your aunt's son is your cousin.
quests.funFact: Your aunt's son calls your own mother or father 'Aunt' or 'Uncle' right back!
